B09GDL6BGY.title: Zooz Z-Wave Long Range Q Sensor ZSE11 800LR | Motion, Temperature, Humidity, Light (Hub Required)
bullets: 4 SMART SENSORS: NEW 800LR version with improved hardware. Get motion alerts and monitor temperature, humidity, and light to take your smart home to the next level. Use this device as the trigger to lighting automations, security alerts, or climate control. It's as versatile and as quick to report as can be. Compatible Z-Wave hub required (sold separately).

FLEXIBLE MOUNT: Use the included mounting bracket to adjust the sensor's field of view and ensure precise monitoring. Power the sensor with batteries (included) or a micro USB cable (sold separately). Always use a single power source only. Works as a Z-Wave repeater when included on USB power.

Z-WAVE COMPATIBILITY: Most basic Z-Wave systems aren't advanced enough to display multisensors correctly. The ZSE11 Q Sensor is supported by: Z-Box Hub (recommended for Zooz devices), works with SmartThings (with a custom edge driver, instructions included with the product), Hubitat, Home Assistant, Indigo, and HomeSeer. Please do NOT buy this device if your hub isn't listed here, it will not be recognized by your system.
MINIMAL DESIGN: Simple and modern look to compliment any interior. This sensor is small enough for discreet monitoring of your home, office, or warehouse space.
MORE SECURITY: Includes S2 Authenticated Z-Wave security and SmartStart for the safest communication possible. Back by a 1-year manufacturer warranty and lifetime tech support.

B00Q59PBZE.title: Smart Motion, Temperature & Light Sensor (HSM200), AC Powered, Z-Wave Plus Technology, Includes Programmable RGB LED Indicator, Compatible with HomeSeer, Home Assistant & Hubitat (1-Pack)
bullets: 🏃‍♂️ Z-WAVE PLUS MULTISENSOR: HSM200 is a versatile Z-Wave Plus sensor that detects motion, temperature, and light levels. It wirelessly sends Z-Wave commands to your smart home hub, allowing you to easily monitor and automate your home environment.

🚦 CUSTOMIZABLE ANNUNCIATOR: HSM200 features an RGB LED that can be programmed to glow in 7 different colors, providing a visual alert when specific events occur in your smart home. You can set the color to indicate when motion is detected, temperature changes, or any custom event you define in your HomeSeer system.

⚡ LINE POWERED - NO BATTERIES NEEDED: HSM200 is powered by a standard 120-volt US-style outlet, meaning you never have to worry about changing batteries. Just plug it in, and it's ready to use, ensuring continuous operation without interruptions.

🦜 ACTS AS A Z-WAVE REPEATER: In addition to sensing and reporting, the HSM200 helps extend the range and improve the performance of your Z-Wave network by acting as a repeater. This enhances communication between devices and ensures reliable connectivity across your entire smart home.

🌎 WIDE COMPATIBILITY: The HSM200 works seamlessly with HomeSeer, Hubitat, Home Assistant, and SmartThings (with the HomeSeer Edge Driver). It’s perfect for users of these popular smart home platforms, but please note, it is not compatible with Wink or Vera systems.
